meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为生成的内容套用 Anthropic 官方品牌样式:标题(24pt 以上)用 Poppins 字体,正文用 Lora;自动回退到 Arial/Georgia,非文字形状用橙、蓝、绿三色循环,产出带品牌统一观感的作品。
howto.when: 当你说到品牌色、风格指南、视觉格式等公司设计相关要求时触发;也可在生成演示文稿、文档等需要品牌观感的内容时调用。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 的品牌配色给这份演示文稿上色
say.note: Claude 会套用官方色板并设置字体。

say.text: 把标题设为 Poppins,正文改成 Lora
给这张图表配上橙、蓝、绿的点缀色
say.note: 形状会按强调色循环上色。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude applies Anthropic's official brand styling to generated content: headings (24pt+) use Poppins, body text uses Lora, with automatic fallback to Arial/Georgia; non-text shapes cycle through orange, blue, and green accent colors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when brand colors, style guidelines, visual formatting, or similar design requirements are mentioned, or when generating content that needs the brand look.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic's brand palette to this slide deck
say_en.note: Claude will use official colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Set headings to Poppins and body text to Lora
say_en.note: Fonts fall back automatically if missing.

say_en.text: Add orange, blue, and green accent colors to this chart
